page.overview:
What is Esperia Kingdom?

The Esperia Kingdom, also referred to as the , was a kingdom in the West Blue. It was Brook's homeland and where he served as a royal guard. The kingdom was famous for making musical instruments and producing music.

62 years ago, the World Government allegedly invaded and destroyed the kingdom due to its inability to pay the Heavenly Tribute and refusal of providing 1000 slaves as substitution, but according to Shuri, the true reason was due to the government demanding she be returned to Mary Geoise, with Reuven refusing to do so.

Esperia used to be a mostly urban island with its primary structure being the massive built at the center of it, part of the castle. It featured a mountainous terrain, with the center of the island rising above the lower sections, as well as a smaller island connected via a bridge.

The overall kingdom appeared to be inspired by , with musical elements, such as notes and clefs, commonly incorporated on the nation's buildings.
